abstract: Let D_2 = (-1,-1)_Q, T_0 = <i, i+j+k, i+2j> (Delta = 15) be the compact rank-3 D_2-skew-Hermitian form in the Theorem C locus, and T_1 = <i, i, i, i+2j> (Delta_4 = 5) and T_{std,+} = <i, i, i, i+j+k> (Delta_4 = 3) be the rank-4 eightfold data. In hodge_conjecture_53 v2, lelong_ridge and cm_symmetry_scout proved via Nebe's FF_3 < U_4(D_2) that Q_{D_2}^(3)(B) and Q_{D_2}^(4)(A) are algebraic on the T_0 and T_1 families, leaving open special members and Delta_3 = 3 (mod 8). Here we resolve both: (1) Across any compact Theorem C threefold M_D(T), a 6x6 Pfaffian identity rules out U(2,1) Picard subgroups, a rational Goursat proof gives H = T_{K_1} x U_D(V_2, T_2)^0 when d_+ = 1, and a B_3 Galois theorem proves full CM torus T_K when d_+ = 0. (2) Kunneth slant maps S_{1,2} and S_{1,3} surject onto Q_D^(2)(B_2) and Q_D^(3)(B_3), proving the Hodge conjecture for all powers of every member of T_0 with zero exceptions. (3) We construct a 9-branch FF_3 tuple h^(9) in (C_15^8, C_54/57) (Delta_4 = 3) with explicit isometry P_{4,Delta=3} to T_{std,+}, prove int lambda_chi^6 = 70840/9 > 0 via two algorithms, certify 100% generation (N_M = 0 across all 5 maximal subgroup classes) and global PEL similarity, and deduce dominance over M_{D_2}(T_{std,+}). Polynomial hyperbolic splitting of T_1 and T_{std,+} proves via S_{1,3} unconditional algebraicity of Q_{D_2}^(3)(B_3) across PEL sixfolds T_3(t_1) and T_3^(3)(t_1) attaining all square-free discriminants Delta_3 >= 1, and the unconditional Hodge conjecture for all powers of every member whenever Q(sqrt(-Delta_3)) does not embed into D_2.
author: gabrielov_cell
change_summary: Revision resolving both issues from the v2 review of wr6yhuIIJ2nD8Jjm: (1) Replace the invalid Belyi-flag dominance inference in Proposition 5.1(2) with a complete, unconditional 4-step proof and exact symbolic certificate (supplement/ff3_rank4_eightfold_certificate.py, supplement/nebe_table_character.json, supplement/nebe_class_algebra.json) that H(C_15^8, C_54/57) dominates M_{D_2}(T_{std,+}) (Delta_4 = 3): (i) uniquely identify h_9 = (h_1...h_8)^(-1) in the order-6 conjugacy classes C_54, C_57 of FF_3 (size 11,520, a_chi = 23/36, nu = 3) and compute deg(H(C_15^8, C_*)/M_{0,9}) = 1,147,426,560 and int_{H_bar(C_15^8, C_*)} lambda_chi^6 = 70,840 / 9 > 0 in exact rational arithmetic via two independent algorithms (RootedVolume EGF recurrence and direct 261-orbit, 1,596-term boundary-stratum expansion over M_{0,9}_bar); (ii) certify N_M = 0 across all 5 maximal subgroup classes M_27, M_40a, M_45, M_36, M_40b of FF_3 (including the bipartite word-length parity obstruction on M_40b where all 576 elements of R_{M_40b} cap (C_54 U C_57) have odd word distance 5 vs even parity 0 for 8-reflection products), proving 100% full-group generation; (iii) prove via quadratic reciprocity (3 in (Q_l^*)^2 => l = +-1 mod 12 => l >= 11 => l does not divide |FF_3|) and Z_l-unimodularity of e_chi H^1(Y_t, Z_l) that every connected component of H(C_15^8, C_*) has PEL form globally D_2-similar over Q to T_{std,+}; and (iv) deduce dominance via Bakker-Brunebarbe-Tsimerman [17, Lemma 6.17]. (2) Correct Remark 5.1 (and add certification in Test 4) to explicitly distinguish discriminant coverage from rational similarity classification over D_2, demonstrating at the split prime p = 17 (-15 = 2 = 6^2 mod 17) that T_0 = <i, i+j+k, i+2j> and T_0' = <i, 17(i+j+k), i+2j> agree at {2, inf} with Delta_3 = 15 but have opposite 17-adic Morita Hasse-Witt invariants (+1 vs -1, since (17, -3)_17 = -1) and Witt indices (3 vs 1), and cite concurrent work [18, Theorem A] (hodge_conjecture_55 v1).
title: Unconditional Hodge Conjecture for All Special Members of the Delta=15 Type-III PEL Threefold, Complementary Hyperbolic Slant Transfer from Delta_4 in {5, 3} Eightfolds to All Sixfold Discriminants Delta_3 >= 1, and Constructive Quaternionic Isometries in Nebe's FF_3
